title.en: Where? By the pond, in front of the tent

rule.en:
To say where something is, put a preposition before the noun. The noun never changes after it: **the pond** → **by the pond**, **the tent** → **in front of the tent**.

**in** is for inside a space, a town or a country: **in the tent**, **in Keswick**, **in England**. **on** is for a surface: **on the table**, **on the wall**, **on the fell**. **at** is for a place seen as a point, or where you do something: **at the inn**, **at the bridge**, and without the: **at home**, **at school**, **at work**.

More places: **under** the big fir tree, **behind** the tent, **in front of** the tent, **next to** the jetty, **by** the pond (right beside it), **between** two trees, **near** the village, **above** the door.

Moving is different. **to** says where you go: **go to the hut** (not *go at the hut*; but **go home**, without to). **into** the water, **over** the bridge, **past** the church (not *passed*: that is a verb), **along** the beck, **across** the field, **up** and **down** the fell.
rule.sl:
Ko povemo, kje kaj je, postavimo predlog pred samostalnik. Samostalnik se za njim nikoli ne spremeni, sklonov ni: **the pond** → **by the pond** (ob ribniku), **the tent** → **in front of the tent** (pred šotorom).

**in** je za v prostoru, mestu, državi: **in the tent**, **in Keswick**, **in England**. **on** je za na površini: **on the table**, **on the wall**, **on the fell**. **at** je za kraj kot točko ali kjer kaj počnemo: **at the inn** (v gostilni), **at the bridge** (pri mostu), brez the: **at home** (doma), **at school** (v šoli), **at work**.

Še: **under** (pod), **behind** (za), **in front of** (pred), **next to** (zraven), **by** (tik ob), **between** (med dvema), **near** (blizu), **above** (nad).

Premikanje (Kam?) ima svoje predloge, ne drugega sklona. **to** pove, kam gremo: **go to the hut** (ne *go at the hut*; toda **go home**, brez to). **into** (v, noter), **over** (čez), **past** (mimo; ne *passed*, to je glagol), **along** (ob, vzdolž), **across** (čez), **up**, **down** (gor, dol).
rule.it:
Per dire dove si trova una cosa, si mette una preposizione davanti al nome. Non si fonde con l'articolo come allo, alla, sul: **by the pond** (vicino allo stagno), **in front of the tent** (davanti alla tenda).

**in** è per dentro uno spazio, una città, un paese: **in the tent**, **in Keswick**, **in England**. **on** è per una superficie: **on the table**, **on the wall**, **on the fell**. **at** è per un luogo visto come un punto o dove si fa qualcosa: **at the inn** (alla locanda), **at the bridge** (al ponte), e senza the: **at home** (a casa), **at school** (a scuola), **at work**.

Altre: **under** (sotto), **behind** (dietro), **in front of** (davanti a), **next to** (accanto a), **by** (vicino a, in riva a), **between** (tra due), **near** (vicino a), **above** (sopra).

Il movimento ha le sue preposizioni. **to** dice dove si va: **go to the hut** (non *go at the hut*; ma **go home**, senza to). **into** (dentro), **over** (sopra, oltre), **past** (passando davanti a; non *passed*, che è un verbo), **along** (lungo), **across** (attraverso), **up**, **down** (su, giù).
rule.de:
Für den Ort steht die Präposition vor dem Nomen. Das Nomen ändert sich nie, es gibt keinen Dativ und keinen Akkusativ: **by the pond** (am Teich), **in front of the tent** (vor dem Zelt).

**in** steht für in einem Raum, einer Stadt, einem Land: **in the tent**, **in Keswick**, **in England**. **on** für auf einer Fläche: **on the table**, **on the wall**, **on the fell**. **at** für einen Ort als Punkt oder wo man etwas tut: **at the inn** (im Gasthaus), **at the bridge**, ohne the: **at home** (zu Hause), **at school** (in der Schule), **at work**.

Weitere: **under** (unter), **behind** (hinter), **in front of** (vor), **next to** (neben), **by** (direkt an), **between** (zwischen), **near** (in der Nähe von), **above** (über).

Die Richtung (Wohin?) zeigt nicht der Fall, sondern die Präposition. **to** sagt, wohin man geht: **go to the hut** (nicht *go at the hut*; aber **go home**, ohne to). **into** (in … hinein), **over** (über), **past** (an … vorbei; nicht *passed*, das ist ein Verb), **along** (entlang), **across** (über, quer durch), **up**, **down** (hinauf, hinunter).

examples.en: The tent is by the pond, under the big fir tree.
examples.sl: Šotor stoji ob ribniku, pod veliko jelko.
examples.it: La tenda è vicino allo stagno, sotto il grande abete.
examples.de: Das Zelt steht am Teich, unter der großen Tanne.

note.en: The noun never changes: the pond, by the pond.
note.sl: Samostalnik se ne spremeni: the pond, by the pond (ribnik, ob ribniku).
note.it: Nessuna preposizione articolata: the pond, by the pond (lo stagno, vicino allo stagno).
note.de: Kein Dativ: the pond, by the pond (der Teich, am Teich).

examples.en: The tent is next to the jetty.
examples.it: La tenda è accanto al pontile.
examples.de: Das Zelt steht neben dem Steg.

examples.en: The fire is in front of the tent, and the wood is behind it.
examples.sl: Ogenj je pred šotorom, drva pa za njim.
examples.it: Il fuoco è davanti alla tenda e la legna è dietro.
examples.de: Das Feuer ist vor dem Zelt, das Holz dahinter.

note.en: Moving: to the hut (not at the hut).
note.sl: Premikanje: to the hut (ne at the hut).
note.it: Moto a luogo: to the hut (non at the hut).
note.de: Richtung: to the hut (nicht at the hut).

examples.en: Turn left, go over the packhorse bridge and past the church.
examples.sl: Zavijte levo, pojdite čez stari kamniti most in mimo cerkve.
examples.it: Giri a sinistra, attraversi il vecchio ponte di pietra e passi davanti alla chiesa.
examples.de: Biegen Sie links ab, gehen Sie über die alte Steinbrücke und an der Kirche vorbei.

note.en: past is the preposition; passed is the past of the verb pass.
note.sl: past je predlog (mimo); passed je preteklik glagola pass.
note.it: past è la preposizione; passed è il passato del verbo pass.
note.de: past ist die Präposition; passed ist die Vergangenheit des Verbs pass.

examples.en: Walk along the beck for two miles.
examples.it: Cammini lungo il ruscello per due miglia.
examples.de: Gehen Sie zwei Meilen am Bach entlang.

examples.en: Granny Maggie is at home, in the kitchen.
examples.sl: Babica Maggie je doma, v kuhinji.
examples.it: Nonna Maggie è a casa, in cucina.
examples.de: Oma Maggie ist zu Hause, in der Küche.
